entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A thief and Planeswalker who remarks on stealable security.

entities.name: Brago
entities.description: The ghostly King Eternal of Fiora, whose rule persists beyond death.

entities.name: Marchesa
entities.description: Marchesa, the Black Rose, a power player in Paliano.

entities.name: Selvala
entities.description: A ranger of the Lowlands who opposes the High City.

entities.name: Grenzo
entities.description: A dungeon warden who speaks of the price of revolution.

entities.name: Muzzio
entities.description: An artificer of Paliano who takes pupils and argues with Selvala.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Grand Cenobite, who seeks something far greater than the fight at hand.

entities.name: Kal Lior
entities.description: A leonin elder.

entities.name: Kaalia of the Vast
entities.description: A character who prefers loyalty out of respect, not magic.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: A Planeswalker who cleansed the Ninth District.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A Planeswalker necromancer who values minions that know her wishes.

entities.name: Zul Ashur
entities.description: A lich lord who speaks of zombie anatomy.

entities.name: Savra
entities.description: A character who speaks of the Plagued Rusalka.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem who tells a fable of the elf and gold.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An artificer who thought a venture a crusade.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: A companion of Urza who saw the venture as a robbery.

entities.name: Phage
entities.description: A character who drank the energy of victims; she is Phage the Untouchable.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A person whose memory stirs in Phage.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A character who set a bomb against Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A being accused of treachery.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: A character aboard a ship who warns of boarders.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A character who answers Orim.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: A character who speaks of the Altar of Dementia.

entities.name: Mirri
entities.description: A cat warrior of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Tahngarth
entities.description: A minotaur of the Weatherlight.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: A millennia-old vampire.

entities.name: Reya Dawnbringer
entities.description: An angel who claims the dead may not die without her consent.

entities.name: Edric
entities.description: A spymaster of Trest.

entities.name: Basandra
entities.description: A battle seraph who prefers the lash.

entities.name: Hildin
entities.description: A priest of Avacyn.

entities.name: Britta
entities.description: A midwife of Gatstaf.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: An angel whose return brought back gryffs.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: A plane ruled by King Brago.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: The High City, where all are pawns in someone's play for power.

entities.name: Lowlands
entities.description: The region of Paliano that refuses to suffer at the High City's whims.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane with toll roads and bridges.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane that fortifies itself against the Great Threat.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane touched by temporal energies.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A plane where no one has died of old age.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that uses hawks as messengers.

entities.name: Boros
entities.description: A Ravnican guild no ganglord challenged after Gideon cleansed the Ninth District.

entities.name: Simic
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that created stasis cells.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that uses stasis cells on the guilty.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: A place with a Great Library guarded by scrollkeepers.

events.summary: Gideon cleanses the Ninth District, after which none of the ganglords challenge the Boros.
events.quote: After Gideon cleansed the Ninth District, none of the ganglords challenged the Boros.

events.summary: Urza thinks his venture a crusade while Xantcha knows it is a robbery.
events.quote: Urza thought it a crusade. Xantcha knew it was a robbery.

events.summary: Freyalise sets a bomb against Yawgmoth, accusing him of treachery.
events.quote: "Yawgmoth," Freyalise whispered as she set the bomb, "now you will pay for your treachery."

events.summary: Orim warns that if the enemy boards them they are finished; Crovax nods.
events.quote: "If they board us we're finished," warned Orim.

events.summary: Phage drinks the energy of victims as a memory of Jeska stirs, then fades.
events.quote: As Phage drank their energy, a vague memory of Jeska stirred.

events.summary: The scrollkeepers of Minamo stay at the doors of the Great Library as ogres and oni masters sweep through.
events.quote: The scrollkeepers never stepped an inch away from the doors of the Great Library

events.summary: Gryffs thought extinct reappear with Avacyn's return.
events.quote: Long thought to be extinct, flocks of gryffs reappeared with Avacyn's return.

relations.quote: On Fiora, no matter is settled until King Brago offers an opinion.

relations.note: Selvala says the Lowlands refuse to suffer the High City's whims.
relations.quote: "The Lowlands refuse to suffer at the whims of the High City."

relations.note: Marchesa says all who enter Paliano are pawns in someone's play for power.
relations.quote: "All who set foot in Paliano are pawns in someone's play for power."

relations.note: The Orzhov use hawk messengers to bypass toll roads across Ravnica.
relations.quote: The Orzhov started using hawks as messengers in order to bypass the many toll roads and bridges that dot Ravnica.
